verdict.rationale: vLLM's own CLI documents a command that "Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server," with an official Docker image for the same purpose. The server applies across 200+ Hugging Face architectures plus the Transformers backend, and `--trust-remote-code` is documented for online serving. A community user also confirms using the OpenAI-compatible API with ChatGPT applications. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of which OpenAI endpoints are covered, and hands-on corroboration of launching the server for arbitrary models.

support.subject: As a developer, I can launch a local OpenAI-compatible API server for any loaded model

citations.quote: Starts the vLLM OpenAI Compatible API server.
The image can be used to run OpenAI compatible server and is available on Docker Hub as vllm/vllm-openai
vLLM seamlessly supports 200+ model architectures on HuggingFace
simply set `trust_remote_code=True` for offline-inference or `--trust-remote-code` for the online serving.
Cool, I prefer the OpenAI-Compatible api.
